verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com, which hosts Atlas's own documentation. Atlas pages are also served as agent-friendly Markdown (e.g. atlas.md, atlas/signup.md, atlas/83b-election.md), so an agent can ingest them directly. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt specifically indexes the Atlas section, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
